text: Gabi, a forestry worker in South Africa's Tsitsikamma forest, goes after a lost drone and steps on a trap that drives a stake through her foot. She is nursed in a wooden house by Barend, a former plant pathologist, and his son Stefan, who live alone among the trees and [leave offerings at an ancient tree|wants|the sacrifice demanded]. At night fungus-covered people stalk the house, [mushrooms sprout from living flesh|rules|it gets inside you], and Barend speaks of a vast organism [waiting to spread|wants|spreading and taking over]. Stefan's mother [has become a tree|images|plants, trees and fungus], still wearing her wedding ring.
